For each conflicting (entity, predicate) key, you are given the common ancestor's value (if any) and each branch's current value, source, and confidence. 'source' is how that update was recorded: "user" means the user explicitly stated or corrected it; "inference" means the agent inferred or guessed it; "observation" means the agent observed it indirectly. Do NOT use timestamps to decide, even if you can infer relative recency — two branches that were disconnected from each other have no shared clock, so 'later' does not mean 'more correct' here.
